newsitem.title: USA: TVA cuts output at Browns Ferry 2 nuke.
newsitem.headline: TVA cuts output at Browns Ferry 2 nuke.

text.p: TVA Nuclear has reduced power output at its Browns Ferry 2 nuclear power plant to 29 percent of its 1,065 megawatt (MW) capacity, Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Monday.
NRC said reduction at the plant, in Decatur, Ala., was for "maintenance on miscellaneous drain header."
The daily NRC report, based in information provided by the plant's operator, did not give an approximate time for restoring the plant to full output.
Browns Ferry 1 is already shut for refueling while Browns Ferry 3 is currently producing at 83 percent and coasting down ahead of a scheduled outage.
All three Browns Ferry units are rated at 1,065 MW.
TVA Nuclear, as a matter of policy, does not comment on the status of its power plants.
